trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

**Situation:** checkout-api was running v2.3.1 and failing health checks across all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. The v2.3.1-rc release in staging showed the same unhealthy status.

**Actions taken:**
1. **Rolled back** checkout-api to **v2.3.0** — the most recent version with healthy production status — across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rollback was verified as successfully rolled out.
2. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** titled "checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy," documenting the unhealthy v2.3.1 release and the rollback remediation. The on-call engineer has been paged.

The incident is now open for the on-call engineer to investigate the root cause of the v2.3.1 regression.
